messages:
jordan: noticed a spike of session resets this morning, lots of 502s coming from edge-proxy and clients are getting silent closes. Dashboard shows duplicate token counts in billing.
maya: saw that too. looks like the proxy is returning a reset instead of gracefully closing the SSE connection. is it a config rollback? :thinking:
ryan: not a rollback afaik. we rolled a keepalive tweak yesterday. proxy team changed the upstream idle timeout from 90s -> 30s for one canary.
casey: that explains the surge. users who resume are getting billed twice because our resume path doesn't dedupe when the prior session got RESET vs CLEAN_CLOSE.
casey: current console UX shows "reconnects" in one metric and "duplicate-charges" in another; hard to correlate. we need a single traceable tag.
dana: +1, we need a telemetry field on the resume metric indicating prior close reason. add something like `close_reason:{clean,reset,timeout}` and surface it in the rollout dashboard.
ryan: quick patch: proxy can set `x-session-terminated: reset` on the 502. then our gateway can map that to `close_reason=reset` before forwarding to resume logic.
jordan: is that safe? any chance proxies will attach that header for other kinds of errors and we over-index on it?
yan: we'll only honor it when status == 502 and connection was half-closed. otherwise ignore.
casey: with that we can change console to show a small heatmap: resume_success_rate by close_reason and by route. would help rollouts.
maya: operational question: do we want to treat `reset` as non-resumable and force clients to open fresh sessions? that'll avoid dup billing but could increase errors for long-lived clients.
dana: prefer non-resumable for now. cheaper and predictable. we can do a graceful fallback: if session had no outstanding tokens (idle), allow resume; else force new session.
jordan: implementation plan.
- ry an: add header mapping in proxy -> backend (fast follow), feature-flag it.
- maya: add `close_reason` tag in metrics + update resume logic to consult it (feature-flagged).
- casey: update console with heatmap + add an alert: resume_failures_by_close_reason > 1% over 5m.
- dana: coordinate rollout schedule and a rollback plan; add playbook entries for investigating increased fresh session creations.
casey: also adding a short note in rollout UX: when flipping route policy, show expected effect on resume vs fresh session counts so PMs know tradeoffs.
jordan: timeline? can we ship the telemetry header and metric in the next 4 hours? don't want another business-critical spike before EOD.
ryan: I can push the proxy PR in 2hrs, feature-flag default off. may a, you ok to toggle metric ingestion once header exists?
maya: yes. I'll wire the metric and a mapping in resume code. will test locally with `curl -H \"x-session-terminated: reset\"`.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: proxy-canary-191 -> prod-canary (depends on manual approval).
dana: I'll approve once proxy PR is up and we have a smoke test that simulates client half-close and verifies header lands.
jordan: cool. after rollout, let's run a script to compare resume_success_rate by close_reason and verify duplicate charge signals drop.
casey: I'll add a short console card for the on-call to see both metrics in one pane.
ryan: one more: add an idempotency token check on resume acceptance to further reduce dup charges. followup ticket created.
jordan: thanks team. logging followups in the ticket thread. :thumbsup:
